title: Why you forget why you walked into a room

lines.text: You walk into the kitchen… and just stand there.
Why did you come in here?
Your brain stores memories in scenes, like chapters in a video game.
Walk through a doorway, and your brain goes: new room, new chapter. Save and close.
Your reason for coming in? It stayed in the old chapter.
Researchers tested it in 2011. A doorway made people forget more than the same walk inside one room.
Quick fix: go back to where you had the thought.
Or do what everyone does. Open the fridge, and act like that was the plan.
